note: D08A32 ammo box icons: original 14x14 pieces in Time to Kill's style inside a 16x16 canvas, by MusicMonsterMod (D24A). Each frame has a full-colour PNG and its 15-colour HUD reduction (-15col). tools/local/build_ammo_icons.py turns the -15col frames into src/ttk/ammo_icons.h.

weapons.name: CROSSBOW
weapons.note: Frames 0 rest (3+ bolts), 1-3 shot / +1 / +2, 4 two left, 6 the 3->2 step, 7-9 the 2->1 shot, 10 one left, 11-12 the last shot, 13 empty (blank). Frame 5 is unused (frame 2 again).

weapons.name: DESERT EAGLE
weapons.note: Frames 0-4 rest with 0-4+ rounds in the clip; 5-19 shot / +1 / +2 from a clip of 1..5+ (5 + 3*(n-1)); 20-21 the empty magazine drops; 22-23 a loaded one rises.

weapons.name: GATLING GUN
weapons.note: No frames: the Gatling keeps the game's own stepping cartridge belt (user decision).

weapons.name: ENERGY WEAPON
weapons.note: Frame 0 rest; a shot plays 1-7 at 60 ms then 0; held fire keeps cycling and finishes on 0.

weapons.name: FREEZER
weapons.note: Frame 0 rest; a shot flashes 1 (peak), 2 (mid), 3 (low) and settles; held fire pulses 1, 2, 3, 2.

weapons.name: LASER GATLING
weapons.note: D08A40: the Gatling's upgrade (record 28, shown while slot 7 has inventory bit 8). An industrial laser charge: a steady beam in the window and a beam between two emitters. Frame 0 rest; a shot plays 1-7 at 60 ms then 0 (the energy weapon's timing); held fire keeps cycling.
